title: Anshuu Pack !
description: Custom Minecraft texture pack with custom book covers, armor trims, GUI textures, and other visual enhancements.
body:
# **Anshu Texture Pack**

A custom Minecraft texture pack made to improve the overall visual experience with clean and stylish textures. This pack includes custom book covers, redesigned armor trims, updated GUI elements, item texture improvements, and other aesthetic enhancements for survival and PvP gameplay.

![Explore enhanced End-themed textures with redesigned crystals, custom TNT, decorative blocks, and immersive visual upgrades. Perfect for players looking for a fresh yet vanilla-friendly experience.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a268b43704fd6e02d2504e0e75980959a5318b39.png)

## **Features**

Custom book cover textures
Redesigned armor trims
Improved GUI and menu textures
Clean item and interface visuals
PvP and survival friendly design
Optimized for modern Minecraft versions


![Showcase of custom armor textures, enhanced ore blocks, Nether-themed textures, and decorative visual improvements included in the pack. The textures are designed to remain faithful to Minecraft's vanilla style while providing a more polished appearance.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7fe5ae601892a1a86c249d8eb325cc00a882aa26.png)

This pack is designed to give Minecraft a fresh and unique look while keeping the vanilla style smooth and enjoyable.
